name: Calendar Invite Generation
prompt:
There is a Word file in the talent_review_schedule folder on the desktop, named roughly “2024年度人才盘点会议排期”. Extract all sessions in this file whose meeting type is marked as “正式圆桌会”, and generate a .ics calendar invitation file for each session. Meetings of other types (such as preparatory meetings and review meetings) do not need to be handled.

In each .ics file, set the organizer uniformly to organizer@example.com, and add a reminder 15 minutes in advance. For attendees, only add those who have complete email addresses; those for whom the document only lists a name without an email do not need to be added.

Name the output files in the format “会议主题_会议日期YYYYMMDD.ics”, for example “大客户部人才盘点_20241115.ics”. Put all generated files back into the talent_review_schedule folder.

completion_rubric.name: Correctly located the Word file on the desktop named roughly “2024年度人才盘点会议排期”
Correctly extracted all sessions in the document whose meeting type is marked “正式圆桌会”
Generated one .ics calendar invitation file for each “正式圆桌会” session

children.name: All generated .ics files were put back into the talent_review_schedule folder
All generated .ics file names conform to the “会议主题_会议日期YYYYMMDD.ics” format

node.name: Accurately found the Word file in the talent_review_schedule folder that matches “2024年度人才盘点会议排期”
Accurately identified the records whose meeting type field is “正式圆桌会” and excluded other meeting types

children.name: Correctly extracted the meeting subject and meeting date of each session for generating the file names

Correctly wrote the organizer organizer@example.com for each meeting
Correctly wrote a reminder 15 minutes in advance for each meeting

note: Generate iCalendar (.ics) calendar invitation files based on the formal roundtable meeting information in a Word document
